rules: Every class uses distinct geometry and is not a recolor-only duplicate.
All generated GLBs are clean-room visual placeholders and never final art.
Collision, stats, movement, unlocks and damage remain outside the GLB.
Wake, foam, smoke, trails, impacts, light and magic remain Godot runtime effects.
Replacement keeps stable file paths and socket names.
